sections.title: Finishing the year
sections.content: You know all twelve months from A1. Here are *május* to *december* again, so you can use them with this lesson's week words: *május*, *június*, *július*, *augusztus*, *szeptember*, *október*, *november*, *december*. "In" a month is the same *-ban* or *-ben* by vowel harmony as in A1.

items.english: In October I work a lot.
In December I don't work, I just rest.

sections.content: You now know all twelve months — combined with *hétfőn*, *kedden*... from A1, you can already place almost anything in the calendar.
